title: Plasma Computer AI (Signature) — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Mirrors its public twin record: An AI that lives in plasma: wave neurons, plasma memory, wave-speed reflexes. The Signature extension gives the plasma AI a persistent identity: it keeps a continuous spheromak-archive memory of every session, so it genuinely remembers its users. This is a Signature-concept extension (speculative): it is an original design proposal for the JAH system, never presented as established physics.
